item.title: Prankster 'Ross Creations' Gets Backlash, Being Investigated For Launching An Opossum In A Catapult
item.description: The Ross Creations Opossum Launcher Controversy refers to backlash towards prank YouTuber RossCreations, real name Charles Ross, over a video where he lures an opossum into a catapult and launches it into the air. The video was uploaded to Instagram Reels in late November 2025 and quickly inspired backlash as viewers accused Ross of animal cruelty.
